# Project agent memory

This file is the project's committed home for project-intrinsic agent knowledge: build, test, release, architecture, and sharp-edge notes that should travel with the code.

1. Static site on GitHub Pages under `/weather/`. No build step, no backend, no secrets in the client. Keep every path relative. Layout, local serving, and tests: see README.md.
2. Data honesty is the product: model, SNOTEL station estimate, NOAA analysis, observer board, and official (CAIC) values stay labeled separately and are never mixed; missing is `null` and renders as a dash, never zero; model spread is never called a probability. Accumulation goes through `integrate()` in `core.js`, which refuses incomplete windows. Do not scrape OpenSnow, CAIC station tables, or resort sites (their terms forbid it).
3. Open-Meteo model ids in `MODELS` (locations.js) were verified against Colorado coordinates. Some "seamless" ids (MET Norway, KNMI, DMI) silently fall back to ECMWF outside Europe, and GraphCast, BOM, and KMA return no snowfall here; re-probe before adding ids.
4. `data/grid.json`, `data/model-ranking.json`, `data/snowpack-history.json`, `data/boards.json`, and `data/hires/` are generated by `scripts/` via `.github/workflows/data.yml` and served from the `data` branch; do not hand-edit them. The site must render when any of them is missing. The owner edits `data/skiers.csv`, `data/facts.csv`, and `data/guestbook.json` directly on GitHub.
5. SNOTEL daily values are end-of-day readings (verified against hourly data): change on day D is reading(D) minus reading(D-1). `measuredDay` in `core.js` is a station estimate, max(depth-gain rule, `SNOTEL_SNOW_RATIO` x water gain on days with TMAX at or below `SNOTEL_WATER_MAX_F`), calibrated against observer boards (snow research report, 2026-10-21); re-check the ratio each season.
6. MapLibre is pinned to the 5.x UMD build with SRI in `map.js`. 6.x is ESM-only and loads its worker from the CDN origin, which breaks cross-origin; do not bump to 6 without self-hosting. Use `map.getSource(...)` guards, not `map.isStyleLoaded()`, before updating layers; the latter is false while tiles load and silently drops updates.
7. avalanche.org map-layer `start_date`/`end_date` carry no offset but are UTC (the feature's `timezone` names the center). Always go through `bulletinWindow` in `core.js`.
8. Every fetch goes through `request()` in `core.js` (timeout plus bounded retry) and every source through `loadSource()` in `app.js` (isolated, with a labeled saved copy on failure). Panels render through `safe()`, and views through `setHTML()`, which keeps keyboard focus across re-renders.

## Maintaining this file

Keep this file for knowledge useful to almost every future agent session in this project.
Do not repeat what the codebase already shows; point to the authoritative file or command instead.
Prefer rewriting or pruning existing entries over appending new ones.
When updating this file, preserve this bar for all agents and keep entries concise.
